content: We have carbon NMR shifts: 135.80, 117.40, 70.50, 54.00, 43.70 ppm. Need number of C=O groups. Carbonyl carbons typically appear around 160-220 ppm for ketones, aldehydes, esters, acids; but 135-117 ppm could be aromatic or alkene. None in carbonyl region. Could be conjugated carbonyls lower? But typical carbonyl > 150. So likely zero carbonyl groups. Could also use IR to confirm. Let's get IR.
